name: Giltspire Avenger
oracle_text:
Exalted (Whenever a creature you control attacks alone, that creature gets +1/+1 until end of turn.)
{T}: Destroy target creature that dealt damage to you this turn.
blocked_sentences: {T}: Destroy target creature that dealt damage to you this turn.

needs.what: a selector key matching objects that dealt damage to a given player this turn (e.g. `dealt_damage_to: "you"`), backed by a per-turn ledger of player victim -> source oids written wherever damage is dealt to a player and cleared at cleanup
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `damaged_by` reads `state.damage_ledger`, which is keyed by victim permanent oid and written only on the permanent-damage path of the damage primitive; damage to a player is never recorded by source, so nothing can ask which creatures dealt damage to you. `damaged` is only 'has damage marked on it', and `damage_taken_this_turn` is a player total, not a per-source record
